notes.title: Languages Update: EXTENDED!
notes.content:
Added Dutch, Korean and Traditional Chinese

Hope you have a happy holidays and enjoy time with your loved ones!
Best, Lauro.

notes.title: Languages Update
notes.content:
A new update has arrived at Brothers in Hell, and this time: LANGUAGES!

In addition to Spanish, English and Chinese, now the game is also in German, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese are now available.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug on the tutorial that sometimes caused the game to get stuck in slow motion.
Halloween decoration now appears from October 21st to November 10th

notes.title: Added Chinese localization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've added Simplified Chinese localization :D

It's made using google translate so let me know if you find any issue!

notes.title: Patch notes May 26th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented landmines to be placed
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes counted the landmines placed as negative
[*] Adjusted the size of the reactions of Andre and Emerald
[/list]

notes.title: Emoji update is now live!
notes.content: The dialogues with NPC now have multiple emoji reactions to convey certain emotions on the player.

notes.title: The Christmas Update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty settings Casual, Hard and Emissary. Old save games will take the default as Normal
[*] Added Christmas decoration on the Oasis of Vishga, available each year between December 8 and January 8. Go fetch your Christmas hat!
[*] Simplified the inventory system
[*] Added aim assist when using joystick 
[*] Updated Andre and Charles dialogs to be more clear about objectives 
[*] Changed the color of the quest marks !? to differentiate between main and secondary 
[*] Added a tutorial about the main and secondary quests when first arriving at the Oasis of Vishga
[*] Fix Wolf boss not dealing any damage 
[*] Nerf Broken Hearts charm to deal less damage 
[*] Fix to ensure data is saved after liberating a village 
[*] Fixed the equipment tooltip to not show "press to equip/unequip" on unequipable objects 
[*] Fixed some crash issues detected
[/list]

notes.title: Rapid fix deployed!
notes.content: I've noted that the achievements were appearing after closing the game, it's fixed and now should appear right when you unlock them!
